title: Integration deployment & handoff check-ins — 2026-05-12
content:
Weekly sync notes — primary objective: quick status checks for customer integrations in final deployment/handoff phases. Meeting: Tue 2026-05-12 09:30 PT (30m). Attendees: Ava (owner), Liam, Priya, Diego, Maya, customer reps as listed per row. Quick purpose: align on go/no-go items, call out any migration/deploy windows, final testing gates, and post-handoff support schedule.

High level: 
- Focus this week on three near-term handoffs (Nimbus Health, Atlas Labs, BrightCart) plus one longer-term migration (OmniRetail).
- Major theme: verify rollback plans and monitoring hooks are present before traffic shift.

Agenda:
1) Round-robin customer updates (1-2 minutes each)
2) Open blockers and mitigations
3) Deployment windows & SRE alignment
4) Action items and owners

Customer updates (concise):

Nimbus Health (primary contact: Sarah Gomez) — status: final UAT -> staging -> prod pipeline.
- Current state: UAT passed (regression suite v3.4). Staging deploy scheduled 2026-05-14 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic window).
- Blockers: two flaky tests in streaming response smoke tests (SE-4821) — root cause pinned to an edge case in tokenization for newline-delimited tool calls. Diego has hotfix branch (github PR 78) and metrics patch instrumented.
- Risk: if hotfix not in by 5/14, we'll keep staging on previous model version (v2.9) and requeue prod for 5/18.
- Monitoring: logging trace id propagation added, console dashboard tile id: nimbus-latency-xt. Pager rules creation pending (oncall: sriram@sre).
- Next steps / owners: Diego -> merge PR + run staging smoke; Priya -> coordinate customer signoff; Ava -> book rollback/kill-switch runbook in Confluence.

Atlas Labs (contact: Dr. Chen) — status: dedicated infra provisioning + private deploy test.
- Current state: VPC peering and KMS policy review done. Private control plane image build successful on 5/11.
- Blockers: certificate renewal automation failing during bootstrap (internal bug TKT-1120). SRE (Liam) investigating; temporary workaround: manual cert injection during initial boot.
- Performance gating: need to run sustained QPS test (target 200 qps sustained for 30m) before handoff. Load test scheduled 2026-05-15 18:00 PT.
- Compliance: Atlas requires full audit log export to their SIEM; export connector is in staging and needs schema verification.
- Next steps / owners: Liam -> cert automation root cause; Maya -> run export schema check; Priya -> confirm legal checklist completed with Atlas security team.

BrightCart (contact: product ops — Jenna) — status: canary live for two internal routes.
- Current state: Canary route serving 10% traffic from dedicated pool. Observability shows increased 95p latency for long-tail (tokens >1024).
- Blockers: intermittent latency spikes correlated with batching surge when cart-abandon rates spike during promo tests. Suspect batching thresholds too aggressive.
- Mitigation: temporarily reduce max batch size and enable prefix cache warmup. Diego to ship batching config update (canary) and monitor for 24 hours.
- Rollout plan: if no regressions, expand to 50% on 5/16, full by 5/19.
- Next steps / owners: Diego -> config change; Ava -> notify customer of adjusted rollout cadence; SRE -> watch for CPU/GPU scheduling preemption events.

OmniRetail (contact: infra lead — Marco) — status: migration planning phase (longer runway).
- Current state: design review done; runbook draft exists but needs detailed DAG for DB migration and cache priming.
- Blockers: cross-team dependency on inventory service schema migration (internal ticket INV-540). Need explicit migration steps to avoid downtime.
- Action: schedule a dry-run migration in staging on 5/22; require signoff from product and infra.
- Owners: Priya -> finalize runbook; Liam -> schedule SRE involvement; Marco -> coordinate inventory team.

Open blockers & discussion points: 
- SE-4821 (Nimbus flaky test) — high priority for this deployment window. Diego estimates patch ready by EOD 5/12; need smoke run signoff 5/13 morning.
- Certificate bootstrap failures for Atlas (TKT-1120) — moderate priority; manual intervention plan in place but automation needs fix to scale.
- Batching-related latency spikes for BrightCart — medium priority; mitigations staged.
- Observability gaps: need synthetic user journeys for canary routes to capture semantic regression (not just latency). Action: Maya to prototype a lightweight semantic-check harness by 5/18.

Operational notes / reminders: 
- Always include a kill-switch ID in the deploy PR description (format: ks-<customer>-YYYYMMDD).
- For private deployments, confirm KMS key rotation window ahead of cutover — default 48h notice to customer.
- Oncall handover: ensure SRE has a short CTA list and escalation matrix in the ticket.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego: merge PR #78 and run full staging smoke (due 2026-05-13)
- Priya: confirm Nimbus customer signoff channel + legal checklist (due 2026-05-13)
- Liam: investigate cert bootstrap automation failure and provide workaround doc (due 2026-05-14)
- Maya: prototype semantic check harness for canaries (due 2026-05-18)
- Ava: create rollback/killswitch runbook page and link to deploy PRs (due 2026-05-13)
- SRE (oncall): schedule load test window and own post-deploy monitoring (Atlas & BrightCart) (due 2026-05-15)

Notes-to-self / informal items: 
- Reminder: coordinate a 1:1 with Marco before OmniRetail staging run to align on inventory migration DAG.
- Double-check that the Prometheus exporter has token-level breakdowns enabled for BrightCart canary to avoid blind spots.
- We should capture a short customer-facing one-pager for Nimbus explaining the minor model change and why it reduces hallucination in tool-calling flows. Priya to draft.

Meeting cadence / next sync:
- Fast follow: ad-hoc standup Wed 2026-05-13 10:00 PT (15m) to confirm Nimbus staging smoke results.
- Weekly sync: Tue 2026-05-19 09:30 PT (30m) — standard updates + post-deploy reviews.

Appendix / quick links:
- SE-4821 ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-4821
- Nimbus Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Nimbus+Health+integration
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/nimbus-adapter/pull/78

End of notes.

----
Document status: working notes for internal handoff; will move to final after Nimbus staging validation and two more items resolved.
